These findings indicate that Norleucine may influence the function of these proteins through their respective targets, potentially modulating the activity of the Dr hemagglutinin structural subunit. The evidence is consistent with a mechanism where Norleucine could act as a modulator or inhibitor of the Dr hemagglutinin structural subunit through its interaction with downstream targets.
